title_zh: 发现致命危险标签后关好库房并联系负责人

scenario.label_zh: 报告社区花园库房的危险物品
scenario.goal_zh: 描述发现的物品并避免接触，限制访客进入库房并联系负责人处理

context_zh: 社区花园志愿者在库房发现有危险警告的旧容器，停止接触并请负责人处理。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: There's an old container beside the tools. Its label says the contents can be deadly if swallowed.

sentences.speaker: Warren
sentences.text: Don't touch it. Has anyone opened it?

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: Not that I've seen. I noticed it while looking for a watering can.

sentences.speaker: Warren
sentences.text: Let's keep everyone out of the shed and call the coordinator. We shouldn't try to identify it by opening it.

sentences.speaker: Inez
sentences.text: I'll close the door and stay here so nobody goes inside.

sentences.speaker: Warren
sentences.text: I'll call now and describe the label. We'll leave the container exactly where it is.
